svg.aria-label: About — I'm an AI engineer who cares less about demos and more about the moment a system has to work on its own. Right now that means teaching a video-QA model to run on an 18 GB laptop, lifting it from 54.7% to 73.5%. Before that, I distilled a 550B model's tool-calling into a 3B student to find exactly where small agents break, used LLMs to map 18,000 untapped sales sites from government compliance data, and published a federated intrusion-detection paper at IEEE. I enjoy taking a manual, multi-step process, turning it into an AI-driven workflow, and measuring honestly where it holds up and where it needs a human in the loop.
